chunks: My father (peace be upon him) said: Sa'd ibn Abdillah narrated to me from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn from al-Hakam ibn Miskin from Husayn ibn Abdillah from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:

I heard him (peace be upon him) saying: When the servant stands up for prayer, Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, turns His face towards him and remains facing him until he turns his head three times; and when he turns his head three times, Allah turns away from him.
ai.seo_question: What happens to Allah's attention when a person turns away three times during prayer?
ai.summary: In this hadith from Shaykh al-Saduq’s *Thawab al-Amal*, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) elucidates the spiritual mechanics of *khushu* (focus) by describing Allah’s literal turning of His face toward the worshipper at the start of prayer. The scholar notes that the specific limit of three glances or turns serves as a threshold for divine attention; exceeding this indicates a break in spiritual presence, causing Allah to withdraw His gaze, a concept deeply rooted in Shia exegetical traditions regarding the validity of prayer based on inner concentration rather than mere physical movement.
